rules.text: A change to headings 8601 through 8602 from any other heading.

(A) A change to headings 8603 through 8606 from any other heading, except from heading 8607; or
(B) A change to headings 8603 through 8606 from heading 8607, whether or not there is also a change from any other heading, provided there is a regional value content of not less than:
(i) 35 percent when the build-up method is used, or
(ii) 45 percent when the build-down method is used.
A change to subheadings 8607.11 through 8607.12 from any subheading outside that group.

A change to axles of subheading 8607.19 from parts of axles of subheading 8607.19 and a change to wheels, whether or not fitted with axles, of subheading 8607.19 from parts of axles or parts of wheels of subheading 8607.19.
A change to subheadings 8607.21 through 8607.99 from any other heading.
A change to headings 8608 through 8609 from any other heading.
